notes: Uncompressed ORC whose postscript version list is the released ORC v1 (Hive 0.12). ORC v0 is not in this file. orc and orc-uncompressed are the same reader.

cases.title: Two-row int64 column
cases.paragraph: The Postscript ends one byte before the end of the file and stores the version. For ORC v1 that version is the sequence [0, 12]. The final byte is the Postscript length.
cases.notes: Original column berth with values 4 and 7. The bytes were written once and frozen in this file. They are not an upstream test vector. A writer version string inside the container is file metadata, not a copied suite.

cases.title: Empty buffer
cases.paragraph: The final byte of the file is the Postscript length. An empty buffer has no tail.

cases.title: Postscript length is zero
cases.paragraph: The final byte of the file is the serialized length of the Postscript, and that length is less than 256. A length of zero does not identify a Postscript.

cases.title: Tail cut off
cases.paragraph: The Postscript and its length byte must be present at the end of the file. A prefix of the file is not a complete ORC v1 file.
